parameters.query: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation_state (phone, state, context) VALUES ('{{ $json.telefono }}', 'idle', JSON_OBJECT());
SELECT phone, state, context FROM conversation_state WHERE phone = '{{ $('Normalize Message').item.json.telefono }}' LIMIT 1;
SELECT address, clinic_hours FROM clinic_settings WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE conversation_state
SET context = JSON_SET(
  COALESCE(context, JSON_OBJECT()),
  '$.estado_previo',
  IF(state = 'confirmando_cancelacion',
     COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(context, '$.estado_previo')), 'awaiting_nombre'),
     state)
),
state = 'confirmando_cancelacion'
WHERE phone = '{{ $('Merge Context').item.json.telefono }}';
UPDATE conversation_state SET state = 'idle', context = JSON_OBJECT() WHERE phone = '{{ $('Merge Context').item.json.telefono }}';
SELECT phone, state, context FROM conversation_state WHERE phone = '{{ $('Merge Context').item.json.telefono }}' LIMIT 1;

UPDATE conversation_state
SET context = CASE
  WHEN '{{ $json.route }}' IN ('media_warn', 'estudio_handoff') THEN
    JSON_SET(
      COALESCE(context, JSON_OBJECT()),
      '$.pending_prompt', '{{ $json.route }}',
      '$.handoff_reason', '{{ $json.handoff_reason }}',
      '$.handoff_quote', '{{ $json.handoff_quote_sql }}'
    )
  ELSE
    JSON_REMOVE(
      COALESCE(context, JSON_OBJECT()),
      '$.pending_prompt',
      '$.handoff_reason',
      '$.handoff_quote'
    )
END
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.telefono }}';
